new_value: Verified IMPLEMENTED AND TESTED at the current tip - the bead's central 'NOT-IMPLEMENTED in C/Zephyr' claim is stale. The C DAO origin-sequence machinery per spec 09 14.2 R-09-009..016 exists: rpl_dao_build.c reserve_origin_sequence (64-bit origin sequence, reserve-then-commit around TX, R-09-009/010), rpl_dao_tx_persist.c (crash-safe two-slot storage with generation tracking, UINT64_MAX terminal-wrap rejection at :258, seq-0 wire-illegal, keyed per pubkey, retained bytes across restart via hal_storage_redundant), all wired into the DAO build/ingest path. VERIFICATION (all host CMake suites, this worker): rpl_dao_sequence 2/2 (golden lollipop/dodag-version sweeps + exhaustive 65536-pair comparator sweep), rpl_dao_tx_persist 1/1, redundant_slot 1/1, hal_storage_redundant 1/1, and rpl_dao_auth 9/9 assertions (origin authorization matrix incl. fail-closed ordering) - the auth suite required a build repair + API migration first (bead 1hjs, closed; commits 24c42d0e6e, 28687c2ac6, 752d195181). Requirements cross-check: 64-bit sequence ✓ (u64 transcript BE), crash-safe commit before TX ✓ (reserve/finalize + two-slot storage), keyed by pubkey ✓ (origin_pubkey binding), retained after reboot ✓ (hal_storage_redundant two-slot + generation), no equal-sequence rebuild ✓ (strictly-exceeds gate), no wrap ✓ (UINT64_MAX terminal), missing/corrupt state stops origination ✓ (require_persisted + storage errors), no clock/random fallback ✓ (none present). Equal-sequence rebuild and corrupt-state behaviors are exercised by the tx_persist/redundant_slot suites. The one open residual (auth matrix semantic mismatch) was resolved this round - all suites now green, which was the closure gate.
